notes:
Account summary: large defense contractor building an on-prem, air-gapped contact center modernization program. Primary drivers: agent assist to reduce AHT, automated ticket summarization for SOC analysts, secure tool-calling into internal ticketing and CAB tools, and guaranteed reliability during surge events (natural disaster/incident response).

Key quotes: "No external egress allowed — models and inference must live inside our enclaves." — Head of Architecture.

Security posture: requires signed model artifacts, FIPS-compatible KMS/HSM, STIG/SCAP checklist compatibility, audit logs with 7+ year retention, per-token auditability for sensitive workflows. They will not accept outbound streaming to third-party APIs; connector architecture must be purely local.

Model & infra preferences: prefer vetted open models (13B-70B family) that can be quantized/optimized for A100/H100 racks; explicit constraint: vendor firmware and drivers must be on an approved list. Want fallback to smaller model (13B) for spikes with automatic routing and strict fidelity checks.

Commercial/ops notes: procurement needs a detailed SOW + hardware acceptance criteria. Pricing sensitivity moderate — more willing to pay for private/dedicated guarantees and predictable SLOs. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to hit cost targets while preserving token-level audit logs.

POC ask: single-rack on-prem POC to validate: throughput for 800 concurrent agent sessions; median agent-assist round-trip (retrieve+generate) < 250ms; ticket summarization accuracy baseline vs human label set (target ROUGE/BERTScore thresholds); secure tool-calling to internal ticketing (no egress).

Vendor concerns: patch/update process for models in air-gapped env (signed bundles only), support SLAs for on-site engineers during acceptance windows, evidence of prior gov/defense deployments.

Short-hand next steps: deliver air-gap runbook, signed model onboarding checklist, cost breakdown for private vs dedicated, schedule 2-day on-site security walkthrough w/ compliance team.
